method: Independent visual inspection of the exact embedded historical JPEG, enlarged with nearest-neighbor sampling and original-image pixel coordinate axes. No geographic model prediction or native boundary/label overlay was drawn on these independent measurement crops. Original proposed source points were known before inspection, so this was model-independent review rather than a blinded localization experiment.

fittedControlVisualChecks.comment: The historical image contains a plausible corresponding physical road junction. Road names are supplied by current OSM network context; the unlabelled historical image alone does not independently name or date the precise current node center. Visual localization has several-pixel interpretation width.
